description: simpy provides a process-based Python discrete-event framework with shared resources for limited-capacity congestion points. The provider is Project maintainers (see primary page). Geographical and temporal coverage: Models are user-defined and can run as fast as possible, in real time or by stepping through events. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The documentation says SimPy has no supporting features for continuous simulation and can be unnecessary for non-interacting fixed-step processes. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
